Subject: Quick ask: 15-min customer brief + optional review (G2/Capterra)

Hi Liam,

Hope you're well — quick one from our advocacy team. We've been building a short customer spotlight series to surface how engineering teams are using Redwood Inference in production, and BrightLane's latency/cost wins stood out in our pilot notes. Would you be open to either:

- A 15-minute recorded customer brief (informal) where we capture a couple of quotes for a short case blurb, or
- Writing a quick review on G2 or Capterra (we can send direct links)

We offer a few fulfillment options depending on what works best for your org: an Amazon/Eurocard gift card, a $500 credit toward your next Redwood invoice, or a donation to a charity of your choice. If you'd prefer, we can also just do a 15-minute call and take notes (no reward necessary).

If you're open, here's a Calendly link to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/redwood-testimonials/15min. Attaching a one-pager that shows the sort of questions we ask and how we use the quote.

Thanks for considering — would love to spotlight BrightLane if there's interest.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[jobs/contact] phone: +1-415-555-0189
[Attachment: brightlane-case-onepager.pdf (pdf)]

Hi Jonas — thanks for reaching out, this is great and congrats to the team on the rollout. A couple quick questions from our side before we schedule anything: 

1) Our procurement/compliance team has strict rules about gifts/incentives. Can you confirm how the gift card is issued and whether it requires any personal data or signed paperwork from our employees?
2) For the recorded brief, will Redwood publish a video or an authored case study? We prefer a short quote and an internal-check draft before anything goes live.

If the incentive is handled as a corporate credit to BrightLane or a donation to charity, that would make approvals smoother. I'm copying our Program Manager who handles vendor advocacy approvals (I'll introduce them if we proceed).

Appreciate the one-pager — I'll skim and send a note by EOD. If it helps, propose two times and I'll try to pick one.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Engineering | BrightLane

Date: 2026-03-01T08:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick ask: 15-min customer brief + optional review (G2/Capterra)

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging approvals. Wanted to surface two options that typically clear procurement quickly: 

Option A — Corporate credit: we can place a $500 Redwood credit on BrightLane's account (no employee PII required). This posts to your account and shows up on the next invoice as a credit line.

Option B — Donation: Redwood will make a €500 donation to the charity of BrightLane's choice and provide a receipt for your records.

For individual-staff gift cards we usually need a recipient email and mailing address only if a physical card is requested; we can also issue e-gift vouchers that don't require forms. If your policy forbids individual incentives, Option A or B tends to work best.

About publication: we always run any quote or case blurb by you before it goes live. We can provide a one-paragraph draft for review and will not publish without explicit written approval. If you'd like, we can mark the brief as "internal use only" first while procurement signs off.

Attached are our standard fulfillment instructions and a sample quote approval flow so your PM can see the steps. 

Let me know which option sounds best and I'll coordinate the logistics.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Advocacy Manager | Redwood Inference
